FEB Standings

Source: R/feb.R
feb_standings.Rd

League table of a FEB competition season (live standings, or the final classification once it is over).

Endpoint: GET https://baloncestoenvivo.feb.es/resultados.aspx?g={group}&t={season - 1}

table is live (the in-season table) or final (the final classification: only position and the team, every other statistic is NA); the page shows one of the two. Only the first phase of the group is shown.

Usage

feb_standings(group, season)

Arguments

group

(integer required): The site's menu group: 1 Primera FEB, 2 Segunda FEB, 4 Liga Femenina Endesa, 9 and 10 LF-2, 67 LF Challenge, 73 Copa de Espana, 74 Liga U. A group is not a competition id (see comp_id).

season

(integer required): Season END year (2027 = 2026-27), sent to the site as its START-year key t = season - 1.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
groupintegerThe site's menu group (1 Primera FEB, 2 Segunda FEB, 4 Liga Femenina Endesa); not a competition id.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27), the site's START-year key plus one.
competitioncharacterCompetition name on the page header ('PRIMERA FEB').
comp_idintegerCompetition id (CompID) read from the page; ties the site group to the API (group 1 -> 115, 2 -> 118, 4 -> 210).
tablecharacterlive = the in-season league table; final = the final classification once the season is over.
positionintegerRank in the table (Po).
team_idintegerTeam-season id (new every season; joins the schedule and game wrappers).
teamcharacterTeam name as printed in the table (sponsor name, uppercase).
playedintegerGames played (PJ); null in the final classification.
wonintegerGames won (PG); null in the final classification.
lostintegerGames lost (PP); null in the final classification.
points_forintegerPoints scored (PF); null in the final classification.
points_againstintegerPoints conceded (PC); null in the final classification.
point_diffintegerPoint difference (DIF), signed; null in the final classification.
win_pctdoubleWin percentage, 0-100 (the page's '100,0%', decimal comma converted).
streakintegerCurrent streak as a signed integer: +3 = three wins in a row, -2 = two losses.
streak_textcharacterThe streak cell verbatim ('+3').

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in feb_game_info().

See also

Other FEB Functions: feb_game_info(), feb_leaders(), feb_overview(), feb_pbp(), feb_period_scores(), feb_player_box(), feb_results(), feb_schedule(), feb_shots(), feb_team_stats()
